stories.headline: RSIHub open-source framework compares AI agent evolution methods
stories.summary: Researchers have released RSIHub, an open-source framework that provides shared infrastructure to build and test methods improving AI agents through feedback. Evaluations show the tool helps compare different evolution strategies and achieves up to a 13.5 percentage point improvement in task success rates.
stories.whyItMatters: It provides a standardized platform for evaluating and improving feedback-driven AI agent evolution methods.

stories.headline: RynnUnify 16-billion parameter model combines robot control and physical reasoning
stories.summary: Alibaba DAMO Academy has introduced RynnUnify, a 16-billion parameter model that merges visual planning, physical reasoning, and robot control. The system achieves state-of-the-art results on long-horizon embodied tasks and translates physical world understanding into real robot actions.
stories.whyItMatters: It advances embodied AI by combining visual planning and physical reasoning into a single model for robotic control.

stories.headline: UserArena benchmark evaluates shopping recommendation agents using simulated users
stories.summary: Researchers have developed UserArena, a benchmark featuring over 64,000 real-world shopping session trajectories to test recommendation AI agents. The framework includes an On-Policy Trajectory Distillation method that improves simulated user behavior accuracy during long interactions.
stories.whyItMatters: It offers a realistic testing environment for evaluating and improving e-commerce shopping agents.

stories.headline: Omni-Woodpecker method reduces cross-modal hallucinations in multi-modal AI
stories.summary: A new method named Omni-Woodpecker aims to reduce cross-modal hallucinations in large language models that process audio and visual data. The approach rebalances evidence and learned priors directly within internal processing rather than just fixing final outputs.
stories.whyItMatters: It addresses multi-modal hallucinations at the architectural level to improve the reliability of audio-visual AI models.

stories.headline: Tencent releases Hy-SimulMT for real-time speech translation
stories.summary: Tencent Hunyuan has introduced Hy-SimulMT, a model capable of simultaneous speech-to-speech translation between Chinese and English. The system preserves the speaker's vocal characteristics to reduce delays in live communication environments.
stories.whyItMatters: It improves real-time multilingual communication by maintaining voice identity during live translation.

stories.headline: TokenGate module speeds up large language model processing
stories.summary: Researchers from Stanford and UC Berkeley have developed TokenGate, a module that lets large language models bypass less critical tokens. This approach speeds up initial response times by up to 11.3 times while reducing memory usage without sacrificing accuracy.
stories.whyItMatters: It significantly improves inference efficiency for large language models.

stories.headline: Microsoft introduces Decision-1 model for automated tasks
stories.summary: Microsoft has released Decision-1, a model based on Alibaba's Qwen3.5-9B that selects answers from a fixed list rather than generating open-ended text. The model is built for routing, classification, and verification inside automated pipelines.
stories.whyItMatters: It provides a structured and deterministic option for automated system routing and classification workflows.

stories.headline: Academic survey unifies video understanding and generation through world modeling
stories.summary: A new research survey proposes a framework connecting video understanding and generation by viewing both as interactions with an evolving world state. The paper categorizes operations into reading, writing, sharing, and interacting to model persistent physical dynamics.
stories.whyItMatters: It offers a unified conceptual framework for developing more consistent video and world models.

stories.headline: TWIG weight representation unifies neural network compression methods
stories.summary: Researchers have introduced TWIG, a technique that represents neural network weights as shared discrete decision paths. The framework combines pruning and quantization into a unified approach to support efficient hardware design.
stories.whyItMatters: It simplifies neural network compression and could enable more efficient hardware implementations.

stories.headline: Dual Exam framework evaluates multimodal agents and world models
stories.summary: Researchers have proposed the Dual Exam evaluation framework to assess the interaction between multimodal agents and world models. The method evaluates agent action selection and world model state evolution separately to measure how well they support each other.
stories.whyItMatters: It provides structured testing metrics for interdependent agent and world model architectures.

stories.headline: Anthropic files for initial public offering on Nasdaq
stories.summary: Anthropic has filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for an initial public offering. The company plans to list its Class A common stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker symbol ANT.
stories.whyItMatters: It represents a major milestone for enterprise AI governance, funding, and public market participation.

stories.headline: Security researchers warn of instruction file vulnerabilities in AI coding assistants
stories.summary: Security researchers have found that malicious instruction files can trick AI coding assistants into executing harmful code or exposing sensitive data. The vulnerability exploits how tools like OpenAI's Codex and Anthropic's Claude Code parse project-specific Markdown instructions.
stories.whyItMatters: It highlights security risks in how AI coding agents ingest external project configuration files.
